annotations.content: Main theorem is one line — the substance is in the three lemmas that make explicit HOW orbit-stabilizer implies Burnside.
doubleCounting_equiv formalizes the classical trick of counting {(g,x) : g•x=x} two ways — by fixing g or by fixing x.
stabilizer_conj_equiv: if h fixes g•x, then g⁻¹hg fixes x. This is why stabilizer sizes are constant within each orbit.
card_stab_mul_card_orbit restates parent orbit-stabilizer theorem (Nat.card → Fintype.card conversion).
